Stephen King's 'Carrie' Adapted into New Streaming Series

Stephen King's classic novel 'Carrie' has been adapted into a new streaming series. Reviews describe the adaptation as vibrant and bloody, with one critic finding the novel incredible but the series infuriating. Another review noted the adaptation feels incredibly pertinent.
